description: Loader for per-repository PR-only guards. Grok 0.2.93 does not load hooks from <project>/.grok/hooks/ even when the folder is trusted (measured: a project-only guard let an edit land on main), but global hooks under ~/.grok/hooks/ always load. This dispatches into whatever guard the current workspace ships and exits 0 -- allowing everything -- in any repository that ships none, so installing it globally does not impose one repository's policy on the rest of the machine.
